projectOverview.coverSubtitle: Vertically operated agrifood company under Bio‑Ready rules—from sanctioned inputs through опаковане, refrigerated legs and passports our sales teams honour at checkout.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body: Bio Vera operates as an agrifood company that organizes production through contracted growers, coordinates logistics and sells to customers—all under Bio‑Ready transparency. The corridor ambition is single-recipe assurance: Southeastern European cultivation inside EU QA rails without contradictory spreadsheet folklore.

sections.title: Problem
sections.body: European food commerce still wastes energy on brittle folders: Парцелs and chemistry are narrated inconsistently; качество teams chase screenshots instead of timestamps; conscientious Производител miss market access without expensive съответствие theatre; refrigerated custody often fails to reconcile with finance.

sections.title: Solution
sections.body: We replace fragmented narratives with one spine covering Фермаs, Integrity Guard scans, Protocol 360 Производствена партида integrity, refrigerated Мисияs with explicit handovers, retail QR passports, and phased settlement — so auditors, Производител and treasury argue over identical Производствена партида IDs.

sections.title: Продукт
sections.body: Web Производител/доставчик dashboards, Expo-ready mobile ergonomics for парцел teams, logistics partner workspaces for Мисияs and handovers, купувач-facing passports plus admin surfaces for whitelist and exception governance — all hardened for офлайн stretches and deterministic sync.

sections.title: Пазар
sections.body: Initial focus is international Производител who can meet regulated retail programmes that require verifiable dossiers — scaling partner-by-partner into additional compliant trade lanes rather than undifferentiated listings.

sections.title: Бизнес Модел
sections.body: Programme-aligned economics spanning Vera Partner inputs, programme insurance companions where permissible, Vera material/work bonuses grounded in controls, corridor-specific транспорт settlements and secured conditional releases segmented for Производител, logistics and platform uplift.

sections.title: Current статус
sections.body: Operating software stack spanning Фермаs, Integrity Guard primitives, cultivation capture, Производствена партидаs, Мисияs and passports in staged rollout — pilot cohort onboarding, corridor logistics partnerships and QA hardening continue in tandem with selective retail-facing pilots.

sections.title: Пътна карта
sections.body: Near term: broaden pilot Фермаs, deepen cold-chain telemetry, widen купувач dossier tooling, automate settlement narration. Medium term: deeper доставчик tooling for sanctioned inputs and packaging programmes, multinational retail SKUs, and additional certified carriers.

sections.title: Impact
sections.body: Measurable traceability lowers audit drag for procurement, improves Производител цена discovery where documentation is no longer punitive, trims food-safety ambiguity through structured custody timelines, and reinforces consumer trust wherever QR passports surface.

founderParagraphs: Bio Vera is founded by Jovica Mihajlovic, a Serbian national based in Hamburg, Germany, where he has been living and working for the past five years.
He holds a Bachelor’s degree in Communications and Public Relations from the University of Niš, which shaped his understanding of communication, market positioning, and user-oriented thinking.
Over the past години he has been building the Vera марка within IT consulting, deepening experience delivering digital оперативен systems—не generic marketing sites—for complex industries.
With Bio Vera, he applies that craftsmanship to agrifood: transparent, scalable operating infrastructure purpose-built for food chains Bio Vera sells through.
His long-term focus is pragmatic systems that tighten trust across supply chains—with room for the Vera продукт family to grow into adjacent sectors over час.
